sql.label: issue_links
sql.query: SELECT id::text, metadata::text, COALESCE(title, 'NULL'), url, CASE WHEN updated_at > created_at THEN 'moved' ELSE 'same' END, COALESCE(created_by_id::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(updated_by_id::text, 'NULL'), CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL THEN 'live' ELSE deleted_at::text END FROM issue_links ORDER BY id::text
